questions.question: Dr. Mina must train young dentists in patient relations. What is the first piece of advice she should give them?
options: Patient relations are an essential therapeutic tool, not just an accessory
Patient relations are an administrative constraint
Patient relations are reserved for psychologists
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Patient relations are at the heart of the care process, improving adherence and outcomes.' 🦅 Sami: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Sami must create a training center for helping relationships. What is the main objective?
